messages:
Maya: Need a concise benchmark playbook for next Wedwebinar. Focus: latency vs token cost across 3 real workloads. Deliverables: 1 pager + 3 visuals + 2 social variants + routing asks. Who owns what?
Liam: I can run the queries and produce CSVs. Proposed visuals: 1) P50/P95/tail waterfall by model variant; 2) tokens->$ Sankey showing savings from batching + prefix cache; 3) regional map overlay of median latency and $/k tokens.
Priya: Tone: avoid absolute "fastest" claims. Emphasize "predictable economics" and "graceful degradation". Hero line idea: "Control inference spend while protecting latency SLOs."
Sam: Ill mock the 3-panel slide. Horizontal cards so they crop well for social. Colors: teal for econ, deep slate for text, orange for tail callouts.
Aria: For inbound routing: segment by intent. SMB -> trial CTA; Mid-market -> webinar + playbook download; Enterprise -> demo + privacy brief. Add UTM: utm_campaign=bench_playbook&utm_segment={seg}. Route Enterprise leads to AE if intent_score > 70.
Maya: Need two social post tones: product engineer (short) and business impact (slightly longer). Also a 20-word registration blurb.
Priya: Product: "One API, predictable token economics  see 3 workloads and tradeoffs. Wed 11am PT. Register:" Business ROI: "Cut inference spend without breaking SLAs  real-world benchmarks and a routing playbook." 20-word blurb: "Benchmarks and tactics to reduce inference spend while keeping latency SLOs  real workloads, routing, and cost playbooks."
Liam: Sample query snippets for waterfall/Sankey (psuedo-SQL) will be in the CSVs. Ill include per-workload notes so claims can be scoped.
Sam: Figma link incoming. Ill include mobile/social crops and a tiny annotation showing how saved tokens are computed from batching/cache.
Aria: Scoring logic suggestion: combine engagement (register/attend) + technical signals (api key, sdk install). If both high -> AE; if only engagement -> nurture drip.
Maya: Timeline: Liam data EOD today, Sam mocks by tomorrow morning, Priya copy by tomorrow EOD, Aria routing doc by Friday. Ill assemble one-pager Friday for review. Owners: Liam=data, Sam=visuals, Priya=copy, Aria=inbound.
Priya: Quick note: use "up to" or ranges for percent savings unless appendix supports exact numbers. Always tie stats to workload type (dialogue vs retrieval).
Liam: Will include appendix CSVs and brief methodology for legal/ops review.
Sam: Putting a micro-heatmap overlay on the map so PMs can drop region labels. Posting figma link in #design once ready.
Aria: Ill draft the HubSpot webhook mapping and example UTMs, drop into the marketing drive for ops.
Maya: Final ask: two CTA lines for registration page: "Register  see the benchmark playbook" and "Reserve your seat  cut inference spend". Thanks team :rocket:
